name: query_tool_log
description: Query the tool-call log (.specify/runtime/tool-calls.jsonl) for coverage of a spec's DoD items. Wraps evidence-tool-log-bridge.sh, which is the v5.1+ structured-evidence primary path — when MCP is registered, this is the canonical way to ask 'does the tool-log already contain evidence that satisfies DoD item X?' without scanning markdown.

log_path.description: Optional override of the tool-call log path. Default is .specify/runtime/tool-calls.jsonl.
